entry.thought: Good habits spread: cycling, recycling, planting gardens. But water waste and pollution creep in. Air stays clean, river ignored. I see contradiction.

entry.thought: Year 2077: Weimar chose small care over grand change. Gardens grew, cycling spread, but water waste and river neglect persisted. The town is liveable, not thriv
entry.headline: Gardens flourish but the river stays forgotten: Weimar chose bicycles over buses
entry.outlook: Weimar is green and breathable but thirsty; people cycle and care for gardens, yet the river runs thin and private water use remains unchecked.

judged.behaviour: watering lawn at noon in drought

changes.title: Lawns wilt in persistent summer drought
changes.story: Grass turns golden and crisp; some gardens fail as summer heat drains aquifers dry.

changes.title: River runs thin and faintly discoloured
changes.story: The Ilm flows lower each summer; paint residue gives water a faint grey-brown tint.

changes.title: Green roofs now cover many buildings
changes.story: Sedum and grasses now blanket rooftops across town; rain soaks in instead of running off.
